Independence Day with Kay Kraft
2018-03-20T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/lifestyle/check-it-out/independence-day-kay-kraft-1549975

Kay Kraft is embracing the youthful vigour of Independence Day in their newest collection, called Shadhinota-18.

Red and green are celebrated, along with other colours in an artistic compilation as part of this collection.

The Shadhinota-18 collection includes sari, shalwar kameez, tops, panjabi, bandanas, as well as tops, shirts kameez sets etc. for children.

The entire collection is available at all outlets of Kay Kraft.

For more information, please visit www.kaykraft.com
